objective: Make Pulse Feed, LaserStream/WSS, Pump.fun and DexScreener converge on one authoritative BUY path; prevent simulation from authorizing live trades.
invariants: Pulse Feed must reach /api/trading/pipeline/ingress or its server alias and then marketEventBus.publishUnified().
All live discovery sources must converge on EntryEngine/TradingEngine; no source-specific live BUY engine.
DexScreener is enrichment/discovery, not a mandatory gate for Pulse Feed/LaserStream/Pump.fun.
Simulation/mock/random market data must never authorize LIVE BUY.
Do not change SELL, PnL, TP, SL, trailing-stop decision logic in this patch.
verification_required: Run TypeScript/lint/build with project dependencies installed.
Trace a real Pulse Feed event through ingress -> marketEventBus -> CandidateRegistry -> MomentumEngine -> EntryEngine.
Trace LaserStream, Pump.fun, Helius WSS and DexScreener through the same authority.
Verify duplicate discoveries of one mint produce one BUY decision.
Verify SIMULATION/PAPER cannot call live execution.
